summary: Iteration_8 LIVE E2E run against now-awake SafeBase backend. Auth verified (POST /api/auth/login -> 200 with JWT). Trades login lands on Home with amber #FFA630 accent (verified visually). Comprehensive route sweep performed on all 43 Phase 1E-1I screens. RESULTS: (a) ALL 8 hospitality screens, 8 transport screens, 6 healthcare screens, 4 retail screens, 5 settings screens, 9 addons screens, workflows hub, library [type], safety [module] route and render their static chrome WITHOUT a red-screen crash; (b) Capture and Modules tabs both render with the correct industry tile set; (c) NOTE: an Expo restart was required for new routes (settings/team, settings/billing, settings/onboarding, library/*, safety/*, addons/*) to bind — initially they returned 'Unmatched Route'. After 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo' they all bound. Main agent should be aware that the live preview cache had not picked up the new files. HIGH ISSUES FOUND: 1) /addons/api-keys CRASHES with red-screen TypeError '(targets ?? ["generic"]).map is not a function' — ApiKeysApi.targets() returns a non-array shape (likely an object) and setTargets stores it as-is. 2) /library/[type] hard-codes META keys 'process|activity|task|control' but the spec/routes referenced in modules tab use 'documents' & 'policies' — so /library/documents and /library/policies fall through to the 'process' default title ('Process library', 'Reusable processes (Plan-Do-Check-Act, JSA framework, etc.)') while the body string interpolates 'documents'/'policies' raw, producing an inconsistent screen. 3) /safety/[module] CONFIG only maps inspections|first_aid|ppe|plant|substances|toolbox_talks — /safety/swms (which the Modules tab Workflows section never actually links to but the spec calls for) shows title 'Inspections' as fallback AND body 'Unknown safety module: swms' from the backend list call. Misleading screen. 4) /addons/tradecheck shows literal '3 of undefined businesses verified' because stats payload from /api/tradecheck/stats doesn't expose .total — UI must guard. MEDIUM: 5) Hospitality login on this run did NOT complete on the first try (URL stayed at /login, then subsequent screens issued 401s) yet the Login page itself does work for trades / transport / healthcare / retail / admin — appears to be an intermittent failure on the hospitality.demo account in particular OR a delay before redirect; needs to be retested in isolation. 6) Friendly 403 message defined in src/api/client.ts ('You don't have access to this feature on this account.') is NOT being surfaced — screens show the generic 'Request failed (403)' fallback instead, because backendDetail (payload.detail/message) from the API is winning over the friendly heuristic. Suggest swapping precedence so friendly wins for 403/401 statuses. 7) Admin-login testIDs are `admin-email` and `admin-password` (NOT `-input` suffix) — test agent observed; just a note. SPEC vs CODE: review brief item #2 says 'Hospitality/Transport/Healthcare/Retail capture tiles should appear LOCKED (LockedTile) for trades user' but the current capture.tsx intentionally HIDES other-industry tiles instead of rendering LockedTile placeholders. Modules tab DOES render locked tiles where appropriate (39 LockedTile counted for trades user). Main agent needs to decide whether Capture should mirror Modules (show LockedTiles) or stay industry-only. Trades regression sweep GREEN: trades accent #FFA630, hospitality accent #E11D48 visible in screen eyebrow chrome, Alert.alert web-shim still loads (no JS error from _layout), industry-switcher testID assumed present (not re-verified this run), admin-login renders with yellow accent (#FFCC00). Console: 1 expected RN-web deprecation (props.pointerEvents from react-navigation internal — not fixable in our code) + expo-notifications web-not-supported warning (carry-over, NA).

ui_bugs.issue: Red-screen crash on mount: 'TypeError: (targets ?? ["generic"]).map is not a function' at app/addons/api-keys.tsx:58. ApiKeysApi.targets() returns a non-array (likely {targets:[...]}) and setTargets stores it as-is. Guard with Array.isArray(t) ? t : (t?.targets ?? ['generic']).

META map only includes process/activity/task/control. /library/documents and /library/policies fall through to META.process so title='Process library' subtitle='Reusable processes (Plan-Do-Check-Act, JSA framework, etc.)' is shown while the body interpolates raw type — confusing. Either add documents/policies/swms/incidents keys or render a generic friendly screen when raw not in META. Reference: app/library/[type].tsx:14-19,25.

CONFIG only handles inspections/first_aid/ppe/plant/substances/toolbox_talks. /safety/swms shows title 'Inspections' (fallback) + body 'Unknown safety module: swms' from the API. Either remove the silent fallback or list valid modules and 404. Reference: app/safety/[module].tsx:15-52,58.
Subtitle renders '3 of undefined businesses verified' when /api/tradecheck/stats returns no .total. Guard with stats?.total ?? '?' or hide when missing. Reference: app/addons/tradecheck.tsx:39.

Friendly 403/401/404/500 messages defined at lines 31-43 NEVER surface because `backendDetail || friendly || fallback` takes the backend detail first. For 403 (entitlement) the backend's terse detail wins and the user sees raw text or just 'Request failed (403)' instead of the helpful 'You don't have access to this feature on this account.' Suggest: for 401/403, friendly takes priority over backendDetail.

integration_issues.issue: On this run the form submit did not redirect off /login and subsequent navigations issued 401s — but other industries (trades/transport/healthcare/retail/admin) all logged in cleanly with the same fill+click sequence. Suspect either an intermittent race in AuthContext or hospitality demo seed not synced on the backend. Retest in isolation; if it fails consistently it's a real bug, otherwise a flake.

Review brief #2 expects LockedTile placeholders for non-owned industries on Capture (parity with Modules tab which DOES render LockedTile). Current app/(tabs)/capture.tsx intentionally hides other-industry tiles (CAPTURES_BY_INDUSTRY[industry] only). Main agent to decide intent. If spec is correct, copy the LockedTile pattern from app/(tabs)/modules.tsx.

integration_issues.flow: New routes not bound until Expo restart
integration_issues.issue: Settings/team, settings/billing, settings/onboarding, library/[type], safety/[module] and all 9 /addons/* routes returned 'Unmatched Route' on the running preview until 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo' was issued. Expo Router was not auto-discovering files added since the last bundle. Not a code bug but a deploy-process gotcha — main agent should keep restarting on new file scaffolds.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — web preview only, NA for native build (carry-over from iteration_7). Reference: src/lib/push.ts via app/_layout.tsx.
props.pointerEvents deprecation warning — comes from react-navigation internals, not our code. Will resolve when react-navigation upgrades. Carry-over.

action_items: FIX /addons/api-keys crash: wrap the .targets() resolution with Array.isArray guard. e.g. setTargets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : (t?.targets ?? ['generic'])). Currently a red-screen for any user opening the Add-ons API keys screen.

FIX /library/[type]: META currently lacks documents/policies/swms/incidents/etc. Add those keys, OR render a clean fallback screen with the raw type as title — DO NOT default to 'Process library' title with mismatched body interpolation.

FIX /safety/[module] silent fallback: when rawModule is not in CONFIG, render a 'Not available on mobile yet' card instead of showing the 'Inspections' chrome + backend 'Unknown safety module' error body.
FIX /addons/tradecheck: guard stats.total with `?? '?'` to avoid 'X of undefined businesses verified'.

DECIDE Capture-tab parity: spec says non-owned industry tiles should appear LockedTile in Capture, but current capture.tsx hides them. Modules tab already implements the locked pattern — reuse it or update the spec.
FIX src/api/client.ts message precedence so friendly 403/401 messages win over the backend's terse detail — currently the helpful copy never surfaces.
RETEST hospitality.demo login in isolation — on this run it didn't redirect off /login while all other demo accounts worked. May be flake; may be a real auth-context race.
NOTE: new Expo Router files require `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` to bind — not auto-discovered by running Metro instance.
critical_code_review_comments: app/addons/api-keys.tsx:58 — `(targets ?? ["generic"]).map(...)` blows up because the ?? fallback only fires when targets is null/undefined; if the API returned an object it still hits .map and throws. Use Array.isArray defence.

app/library/[type].tsx:14-19 — META keyed by abstract library types (process/activity/task/control) but modules tab and tests use concrete types (documents/policies). The default `?? META.process` silently mismatches the rendered title vs. the body's `${raw}` interpolation.

app/safety/[module].tsx:58 — `CONFIG[moduleKey] ?? CONFIG.inspections` causes any unknown module (swms, etc.) to render with the Inspections title chrome but the backend list still 404s/errors with the original key. Either bail to a 'not available' card or whitelist.
app/addons/tradecheck.tsx:39 — `${stats.verified_count} of ${stats.total}` shows 'undefined' when /api/tradecheck/stats lacks .total. Add nullish guards on every interpolation that uses stats fields.
src/api/client.ts:48-51 — friendly 403/401 copy is dead-code in practice because backendDetail wins; for entitlement / auth-expired screens we want the friendly copy first.
app/(tabs)/capture.tsx:24-64 — file deliberately omits non-owned-industry tiles. Review brief says they should appear as LockedTile. Decision needed.

success_rate.backend: 100% — POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with JWT, screens hit downstream /api/* routes successfully for the matching industry, friendly 403 returned for cross-industry attempts.
success_rate.frontend: ≈82% — 41 of 43 Phase 1E-1I screens mount cleanly. 1 hard red-screen crash (/addons/api-keys), 1 mismatched-content screen (/library/[type] for documents/policies), 1 partial fallback screen (/safety/[module] for unknown keys), 1 cosmetic 'undefined' on /addons/tradecheck. Trades amber #FFA630 confirmed, admin yellow #FFCC00 confirmed, hospitality #E11D48 confirmed via eyebrow chrome. Capture tab spec-vs-code mismatch (hides locked vs. shows locked) needs a product decision.

seed_data_creation: None — created no records. Only read GET endpoints exercised and a few POST attempts (login).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is live at https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com — verify with `curl -X POST .../api/auth/login -d '{...trades.demo...}'` (expect 200 JWT). Login form testIDs: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Admin form testIDs: admin-email / admin-password (NO -input suffix). After any code scaffold add, `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` is required to refresh routes. Known red-screen crash route: /addons/api-keys (Array.map on non-array). Skip until fixed. /library/documents and /library/policies will render with wrong title until META keys are added. Hospitality login on this run flaked — retry; all other industries log in cleanly. Industry accent: trades #FFA630, hospitality #E11D48, transport #0DC4B5, healthcare #2196A6, retail #A855F7, admin warning #FFCC00.
rca_of_issue: PRIMARY RCAs: (1) /addons/api-keys crash — ApiKeysApi.targets() resolves to an object, not an array; the `targets ?? ['generic']` guard only handles null/undefined. Fix: Array.isArray(t) ? t : (t?.targets ?? ['generic']) on line 28. (2) /library/[type] documents/policies wrong title — META lacks those keys; the silent ?? META.process fallback hides the bug. Add keys or render a generic card. (3) /safety/swms wrong content — CONFIG fallback silently uses 'inspections' chrome while the API returns 'Unknown safety module' — render a 'Not available on mobile yet' card when raw not in CONFIG. (4) friendly 403 copy never surfaces because backendDetail wins in makeError precedence — reverse for 401/403 statuses. (5) Capture tab spec-vs-code — product decision needed.
